Class Solution minimumChanges(self, s, k):
n = len(s)
g = [[inf]*(n+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
for i in range(1,n+1):
 for j in range(i,n+1):
   m = j-i+1
   for d in range(1,m):
      if m % d == 0:
        cnt=0
        for l in range(m):
            r = (m // d - 1 - l // d) * d + l % d
            if l >= r: break
            if s[i-1+l] != s[i-1+r]: cnt +=1
        g[i][j] = min(g[i][j], cnt)
f = [[inf]*(k+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
f[0][0]=0
for i in range(1,n+1):
 for j in range(1,k+1):
   for h in range(i-1):
      f[i][j] = min(f[i][j], f[h][j-1] + g[h+1][i])
return f[n][k]
